headline: React Native vs Flutter in 2026: Which Should You Choose?

itemListElement.name: React Native vs Flutter in 2026: Which Should You Choose?

mainEntity.name: Is Flutter faster than React Native in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not in any way users notice for typical apps. Flutter keeps an edge in sustained custom animation because it owns its rendering pipeline; React Native's New Architecture closed the historical gap everywhere else. Real-world performance problems are almost always architecture, not framework.

mainEntity.name: Which should a startup choose, React Native or Flutter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Default to the framework your team can staff: React Native if you have or will hire JavaScript/React engineers, Flutter if pixel-perfect brand UI is the core of the product and you are building a team from scratch.

mainEntity.name: Does React Native feel truly native?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — it composes real platform components, so platform behaviour comes by default. Flutter can match it, but platform fidelity there is a deliberate effort rather than the starting point.

mainEntity.name: Is React Native or Flutter easier to hire for?

acceptedAnswer.text: React Native, by a distance. JavaScript/React is the largest talent pool in software and web engineers convert to React Native in days. Dart engineers exist but are a smaller, separate market.
